crop.notes: top is an unrelated dog story (Alton); the Allen part is the PUGILISTIC column: the Clipper editorial on the Allen-Gallagher fight and a Kansas City note on Allen's benefit. Ends with an unrelated California Joe training item

ocr.notes: long text mostly right, scattered garbled words

title.suggested: New York Clipper on the Allen-Gallagher Draw

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reprinted a New York Clipper editorial mocking the referee's draw in the August 17 Allen-Gallagher fight, saying Allen was robbed of the stakes because he was English.

metadata.notes: masthead: Daily Democrat, Saturday Morning, August 28, 1869

facts.fact: Allen fought Charley Gallagher; Gallagher's second threw up the sponge
The referee met the umpires and declared the Allen-Gallagher fight a draw, saying he did not see the sponge thrown up; stakes and excursion money were divided
The Clipper said Allen had beaten McCoole in under a quarter of an hour but lost the stakes on a foul, with cries of 'kill the Englishman' during the fight
Allen and McCoole were matched for a second fight
Allen was to have a benefit at Frank's hall in Kansas City on Friday night

notes: Benefit item is from the Kansas City Journal of Commerce of the 26th, so Friday is likely August 27. Val McKennie is named as referee of the Allen-McCoole fight.
